criteria.success: returned target set equals expected target set
criteria.top1: first returned target equals the single expected target
criteria.evidence: parent-child, indexed, or missing labels match expected labels

limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; no user documents were indexed.
The graph system and the path-derived system share the same scalar metadata, but the graph system uses the production graph API while the path-derived system reconstructs structure from strings.
Path-only receives task text and the documented extension search filter; it cannot express directory enumeration, depth, or ancestor queries.
Latency is an exploratory engineering measurement, not a controlled performance experiment; repeated timings are not independent task observations.
All seeds use the same 35-task category definition even though names, nesting, package presence, placement, and filler counts vary.
Verification is Windows-only; no cross-platform claim is made.
